results.content:
Returns Policy — Sale and clearance items
Items marked "final sale" (including clearance candles and seasonal decor) cannot be returned or exchanged. The only exception is an item that arrives damaged or defective — those are always covered (see Damaged or Defective Items).

results.title: Damaged or Defective Items
results.content:
Damaged or Defective Items
If an item arrives damaged or stops working because of a defect within 1 year of delivery, we make it right at no cost:

1. Contact us within 14 days of delivery for shipping damage (1 year for manufacturing defects) with your order number and a photo of the damage.
2. We send a free replacement, or a full refund if the item is out of stock.
3. You don't need to return damaged items unless we ask.

This applies to all items, including final-sale items.

results.title: Returns Policy

You can return most items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund to the original payment method. Items must be unused, unwashed and in original packaging. Return shipping is free for customers in the US using our prepaid label; customers in Canada and Mexico pay return shipping.
